rationale: The assistant moved from the lint filter to the vent hose, and once the customer found the crushed, fluffy hose it correctly named that as the cause and gave sensible fixes: straighten it, clear the fluff, unplug first. It advised telling the landlord and called an engineer only if the fault persists, and it recommended no part. Weaknesses are that it did not clearly say to stop using the dryer until the hose is fixed, did not mention replacing a damaged hose, and did not acknowledge the IDV 75 model. The safety panel and the final turn repeat earlier text, and the first reply wrongly asked about a condenser on a vented dryer.
